FROM regions r
JOIN customers c ON r.region_id = c.region_id
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id

    t2.People_Living_With_HIV AS Final_Dataset_HIV
FROM 
    clean_aids_dataset t1

    final_aids_dataset t2 ON t1.Country = t2.Country AND t1.Year = t2.Year
